login anonymous
app_update 2430930 validate

Based on the search results, here's what I found about running ARK: Survival Ascended dedicated servers on Linux:

## Native Support Status

ARK: Survival Ascended requires Windows (or a Windows-like environment) and does not support Linux natively. More specifically, as of 2026 Wildcard still ships no native Linux server binary.

## Running on Linux with Proton

Despite the lack of native Linux support, it is possible to run ARK: Survival Ascended servers on Linux: Linux hosts run the Windows ArkAscendedServer.exe under Wine or Proton (GE-Proton is the common choice), typically on Ubuntu 24.04 or similar.

## Server Executable Names

The ARK dedicated server (ArkAscendedServer or ShooterGameServer) is a 64-bit executable application. The search results indicate that on Linux systems running through Proton, you would be running the Windows version of the executable.

## Docker Container Options

For Linux deployment, container installations will install Steam, Proton, and download the ARK: Survival Ascended server files. Multiple Docker container images are available from the community to simplify the setup process.

The bottom line is that while there's no native Linux server build, running ARK: Survival Ascended servers on Linux is achievable using Proton/Wine compatibility layers or Docker containers.

# ARK Dedicated Server — Hosting Research (verified 2025–2026)

**Critical framing:** ARK ships as **two separate products** that need separate hosting SKUs. **ARK: Survival Evolved (ASE)** — the 2017 UE4 game, cheap and mature — and **ARK: Survival Ascended (ASA)** — the 2023 UE5 remaster, notoriously RAM-heavy and Windows-only on the server side. They use **different Steam app IDs, different mod platforms, and wildly different hardware.**

## Self-hostable?
Yes — both have official, free, anonymous-download dedicated server binaries via SteamCMD. **You do not need to own the game to host** — only to play. (Sources: [ark.wiki.gg](https://ark.wiki.gg/wiki/Dedicated_server_setup), [supercraft.host ASA setup](https://supercraft.host/wiki/ark/asa_dedicated_server_setup/))

## SteamCMD app IDs & start commands

| | ASE | ASA |
|---|---|---|
| **Dedicated server app ID** | **376030** | **2430930** |
| Game client app ID (reference) | 346110 | 2399830 |
| Server binary | `ShooterGameServer(.exe)` | `ArkAscendedServer.exe` (a.k.a. WinGDKServer/`ArkAscendedServer`) |
| Native Linux server? | **Yes** — native Linux `ShooterGameServer` exists | **NO native Linux binary** — must run the Windows `.exe` under **Proton/GE-Proton or Wine** (Ubuntu 24.04 common), or a community Docker image |
| Download size | ~13–20 GB | ~11+ GiB download, budget **well past 20 GB, SSD** |

Cross-checked app IDs on both SteamDB app pages and multiple setup guides; 376030/2430930 agree across [SteamDB app 376030](https://steamdb.info/app/376030/info/), [ark.wiki.gg](https://ark.wiki.gg/wiki/Dedicated_server_setup), [ZAP-Hosting ASA](https://zap-hosting.com/guides/docs/vserver-windows-arksurvivalascended/), [MantaScope](https://mantascope.com/guides/ark-survival-ascended-server-setup).

**Install/update (identical pattern, different ID):**
```
steamcmd +force_install_dir <path> +login anonymous +app_update 376030 validate +quit   # ASE
steamcmd +force_install_dir <path> +login anonymous +app_update 2430930 validate +quit  # ASA
```

**Start command — ASE** (uses `?`-delimited URL params on the map name):
```
ShooterGameServer TheIsland?SessionName=<name>?ServerPassword=<pw>?ServerAdminPassword=<pw>?Port=7777?QueryPort=27015?MaxPlayers=<n>?listen -server -log
```

**Start command — ASA** (different syntax — this trips people up):
- Uses `-port=<n>` (dash), **not** `?Port=`.
- **`MaxPlayers` was removed** from the URL params — you MUST use the launch arg **`-WinLiveMaxPlayers=<n>`**.
- `?ServerAdminPassword=` must be the **last** `?` argument.
```
ArkAscendedServer.exe TheIsland_WP?SessionName=<name>?ServerPassword=<pw>?ServerAdminPassword=<pw> -port=7777 -WinLiveMaxPlayers=<n> -mods=<id1,id2>
```
(ASA maps carry a `_WP` World-Partition suffix, e.g. `TheIsland_WP`, `ScorchedEarth_WP`, `Ragnarok_WP`.)
(Sources: [ark.wiki.gg](https://ark.wiki.gg/wiki/Dedicated_server_setup), [MantaScope WinLiveMaxPlayers guide](https://mantascope.com/guides/ark-survival-ascended-server-setup), [supercraft.host ASA](https://supercraft.host/wiki/ark/asa_dedicated_server_setup/))

## Editions / maps / branches

**ASE official maps (all released, mature):** The Island, The Center, Scorched Earth, Ragnarok, Aberration, Extinction, Valguero, Crystal Isles, Genesis Part 1, Genesis Part 2, Lost Island, Fjordur. (The Center, Ragnarok, Valguero, Crystal Isles, Lost Island, Fjordur were free/community-DLC.)

**ASA maps released as of Aug 2026** (ported/rebuilt in UE5, staggered rollout): The Island, Scorched Earth, The Center, Aberration, Extinction, **Ragnarok (Apr 2025)**, **Astraeos (ASA-original, Feb 2025)**, **Genesis Part 1 (shipped ~July 2 2026, build v91 alongside the "Tides of Fortune" naval overhaul)**. Genesis Part 2 and Fjordur Ascended are on the roadmap (Fjordur targeted ~Dec 2026), not yet out. (Sources: [ark.wiki.gg ASA](https://ark.wiki.gg/wiki/ARK:_Survival_Ascended), [supercraft.host roadmap](https://supercraft.host/article/ark-survival-ascended-roadmap-2026/), [WickedNinjaGames DLC schedule](https://wickedninjagames.com/asa-dlc-release-schedule/), [nexus-games maps 2026](https://nexus-games.com/us/blog/best-maps-ark-survival-ascended-2026/))

**Clustering / cross-ARK travel:** Both support **clusters** — multiple map servers sharing a `-clusterid=<id>` and a common cluster-save directory (`-ClusterDirOverride`) let players transfer characters, items, and dinos between maps ("cross-ARK travel"). This is a top-tier hosting feature: owners routinely want a multi-map cluster, so the panel should let one account spin up N linked servers.

## Mods ecosystem (different platform per product — verified)
- **ASE → Steam Workshop.** Mods are numeric Workshop IDs; server pulls them via `ActiveMods=<id,id>` in `GameUserSettings.ini` (or a mods launch arg). SteamCMD workshop_download_item on app 346110.
- **ASA → CurseForge** (Wildcard's official "CurseForge for ARK"/mod.io-style overwolf pipeline — **no Steam Workshop for ASA**). You pass numeric CurseForge project IDs via the launch arg **`-mods=ID1,ID2,ID3`** (comma-separated, left = highest priority) or `ActiveMods` in `GameUserSettings.ini`; the server auto-downloads them on boot. Note: for crossplay/console clusters every mod must be **console-flagged** on CurseForge or it breaks console clients.

**Popular mods owners expect one-click** (spanning both platforms):
1. **Structures Plus (S+)** — building overhaul, snap points, pickup (ASE origin; concepts partly baked into base ASA).
2. **Super Structures** — S+ successor with resource-pulling from inventories.
3. **Awesome SpyGlass!** — creature/player/structure stat readout ([CurseForge ASA](https://www.curseforge.com/ark-survival-ascended/mods/awesomespyglass), Steam WS for ASE).
4. **Dino Storage v2** — cryo-style dino storage/management.
5. **Awesome Teleporters!** — teleport network.
6. **Automated Ark / Auto-farming** — automation QoL.
7. **Cross-map/cluster & stacking mods** (e.g. stack size mods, "Ark Additions" creature packs).
8. **Custom maps as mods** (e.g. Astraeos began as a premium mod map) — big ASA draw on CurseForge.
(Sources: [CurseForge ARK ASA hub](https://www.curseforge.com/ark-survival-ascended), [supercraft best ASA mods 2026](https://supercraft.host/wiki/ark/ark_survival_ascended_best_mods_2026/), [survivalconfigs best ASA mods](https://www.survivalconfigs.com/reference/ark/best-asa-mods), [Steam Workshop Super Structures](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1999447172))

## Key config files (which setting lives where)
Two INI files under `ShooterGame/Saved/Config/<Platform>/`. Same schema across ASE and ASA.

**`GameUserSettings.ini`** — the main file, `[ServerSettings]` section (plus `[/Script/Engine.GameSession]` and `[SessionSettings]`):
- `XPMultiplier`
- `TamingSpeedMultiplier`
- `HarvestAmountMultiplier`
- `DifficultyOffset`
- `OverrideOfficialDifficulty` (set to `5.0` for max-level 150 wild dinos)
- `ServerPassword`
- `ServerAdminPassword`
- `MaxPlayers` (in `[/Script/Engine.GameSession]` — **but on ASA this is overridden by the `-WinLiveMaxPlayers` launch arg**)
- `ActiveMods` (mods list)
- `AllowThirdPersonPlayer`, `ServerPVE`, `PvEStructureDecayPeriodMultiplier`, `DisableDinoDecayPvE`

**`Game.ini`** — `[/script/shootergame.shootergamemode]` section (breeding, per-level curves, deeper tuning):
- `DinoCountMultiplier` (wild dino density)
- `MatingIntervalMultiplier`
- `BabyMatureSpeedMultiplier`
- `EggHatchSpeedMultiplier`
- `BabyCuddleIntervalMultiplier`
- `PlayerCharacterFoodDrainMultiplier` / `...WaterDrainMultiplier` / `...HealthRecoveryMultiplier`
- Per-level `LevelExperienceRampOverrides`, `OverridePlayerLevelEngramPoints`
- Harvest/stat overrides (`HarvestResourceItemAmountClassMultipliers`), `MaxNumberOfPlayersInTribe`

Rule of thumb to surface in a wizard: rates/passwords/mods = GameUserSettings; breeding/leveling/economy curves = Game.ini. (Sources: [ark.wiki.gg server config](https://ark.wiki.gg/wiki/Server_configuration), [supercraft ASA settings guide](https://supercraft.host/wiki/ark/asa_server_settings_guide/))

## Resource baseline (RAM/CPU per tier)

**ASE (modest, scales with players):** base ~6–8 GB; each connected player adds only ~50–150 MiB. CPU is single-thread-bound (one map = one process, mostly one core).
| Tier | Players | RAM |
|---|---|---|
| Small | up to 10 | 6–8 GB |
| Medium | 20–30 | 8–12 GB |
| Large / modded | 50–70 | 12–16 GB |

**ASA (heavy — FLAG THIS):** the dominant cost is the **loaded map**, not players. **~16 GB RAM per single map is the widely cited minimum**; recommended tier is **~32 GB**, and each additional map in a cluster adds **~12–18 GB**. Slot count adds only a few GB, so a 20-slot single-map server needs roughly the same RAM as an 8-slot one. Needs a **modern high-clock CPU** and SSD.
| Tier | Setup | RAM (recommended) |
|---|---|---|
| Single map, small | 1 map, ≤20 slots | **16 GB min / 24–32 GB comfortable** |
| Single map, modded | 1 map + heavy mods | **32 GB** |
| 2-map cluster | 2 linked maps | **~32–48 GB** |
| 3–4-map cluster | large cluster | **48–64 GB+** |

(Sources: [ark.wiki.gg](https://ark.wiki.gg/wiki/Dedicated_server_setup), [supercraft ASA hardware sizing](https://supercraft.host/wiki/ark/asa_self_host_hardware_sizing/), [dedicatedgameservers.net ASA 2026](https://dedicatedgameservers.net/articles/ark-survival-ascended-server-setup-2026/), [MineStrator ASE RAM 2026](https://minestrator.com/blog/post/ark-survival-evolved-server-ram-requirements-2026), [ServerMania](https://www.servermania.com/kb/articles/what-are-the-requirements-for-running-an-ark-dedicated-server))

## Hosting demand signal
**Very high — one of the most-hosted survival games.** ARK is a flagship SKU for essentially every game-host (Nitrado, GPORTAL, ZAP, Shockbyte, Pingperfect, etc.), and private/clustered servers are the norm rather than the exception because of transfer/cluster play, mod-heavy communities, and rate-boosted "boosted" servers. ASA reignited demand in 2023–2026, and its **Windows-only + huge-RAM** profile means many players can't self-host and actively look to rent — a strong margin opportunity. ASE demand persists (cheaper entry, native Linux, mature mods). Recommend offering **both**.

## Verdict — recommended defaults + wizard options
